# Ángel Guerra

Full Stack Developer
Cantabria, Spain

---

## About

Hi! I'm Ángel, a full-stack developer from Cantabria, Spain, with over ten years of professional experience building software for consultancies and product companies.

Throughout my career I've worked across very different industries, including automotive, insurance, legal-tech and pharmaceuticals. Working in these different domains has taught me how to quickly understand business requirements and focus on solving real problems instead of simply writing code.

One thing that has remained constant throughout my career is the trust placed in me by colleagues and employers. I've had the opportunity to work more than once with former managers and companies, gradually taking on more ownership and becoming involved not only in software development but also in technical discussions, planning, code reviews and product decisions.

I still enjoy learning every day. Whether it's a new language, a different architecture or simply a better way to solve a problem, I believe there is always room to improve.

---

## Beyond work

Outside work I'm happily married and the proud father of three children.

I enjoy kickboxing, have practised martial arts for many years and have spent countless hours playing chess.
